Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Derivatives of parametric" as one blob → ✅ split into: derivatives of parametric, implicit functions.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Derivative f'(x) = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h) − f(x)]/h = tangent slope; rules: sum, product, quotient, chain.  ·  d/dx xⁿ = nx^{n−1}; d/dx sin x = cos x; d/dx e^x = e^x; d/dx ln x = 1/x.
